Results.ReviewText: The assembly is simple and quick.  The legs attach with a locking release button that older models didn't have.  The new design also includes a heat guard on the lid handle.   The only issue I ran into was the handle placement in relationship to the hook on the inside of the lid.  I remounted the handle at 90 degrees from the factory location to have a better grip of the lid while resting the lid on the hook.
Results.Title: Love my Webber

Results.ReviewText: Does everything it’s advertised to, wonderful grill
Results.Title: Excellent buy!

Results.ReviewText:
My wife and I owned a the large Weber kettle grill 25 yrs ago and ended up leaving it at our old house when we sold it . We then bought a Weber 
 Gas grill as time went by we missed the flavor that we had gotten from a charcoal grill. We purchased another Weber kettle grill and now our gas sits under its cover.
Results.Title: Happiness is a Weber kettle Grill

Results.ReviewText: Great grill as always, replced Weber i had about 20 years.  Only complaint is that it came out of box with a small dent in the lid right where it sits on bottom piece so it doesnt sit perfectly flat.  Already has small bit of rust where dent is.  Probably still last 10 years though.  Love Weber products.
Results.Title: Replacement grill

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this new Original Kettle Charcoal Grill 22" to replace my 30 year old Original Kettle Charcoal Grill 22" and am just as pleased with the performance of this new grill as I was with my prior grill.  I enjoy the clean out/vent feature as a improvement.  Great grill!!!
Results.Title: Same purchase 30 years apart

Results.ReviewText: What’s to say that hasn’t already been said? Most versatile piece of outdoor cooking equipment on the market.  Predictable and repeatable results no matter what type of cooking you intend to do.
Results.Title: For Today’s Cave-Man

Results.ReviewText: The grill is great. Easy set up. Only issue, bottom charcoal plate has no outlet for rain water. As a functional design if Weber would design an opening, like the top vent opening, that would allow water to drain it would be wonderful.
Results.Title: Grilling in Virginia

Results.ReviewText: I recently had to throw out a 10+ year old Weber. This replacement is not 1/3 the quality.
Results.Title: Thin skin

Results.ReviewText: Listen I have a weber original. I paid 6.56 cents for pork steaks. Smoked them low and slow and they were better than anything I could buy out. Just get a weber. It's the best charcoal grill out there. Quality is the best! Tbones last weekend. Best ever. Watch youtube and you will be a pro in no time.
Results.Title: Economy

Results.ReviewText: This is an easy to put together grill. Fits great in small areas when storing. Food tastes great!
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: It's very well built and easy to assemble. It is and seems smaller than the original 23" it is replacing.
Results.Title: Original Weber 22"

Results.ReviewText: Overall good grill. Can see great longevity with proper care. Cooks well, easy to adjust heating source. Learning curve required on where to place coals for desired cooking. Used the instructions with mixed results. Hopefully will get better with time. This grill is a keeper!
Results.Title: Overall great grill.

Results.ReviewText: It’s a Weber. That’s all you need to know. My 3rd one. I’ve done everything from brisket to pizza on these babies. Great grill. Never let’s me down.
Results.Title: It’s a Weber

Photos.Caption: Next to my old propane grill.

Results.ReviewText: Before this grill, I’d only ever used propane grills.  My wife was raised in a house with charcoal grills, and I did enjoy the food her father made (also on an older Weber Kettle). Since my propane grill needed burners and grates, my wife and daughters gave me this Weber Kettle as a Father’s Day gift.  I absolutely love it.  I don’t even miss the propane.
Results.Title: A great, versatile grill.

Results.ReviewText: Two obvious issues:  Most obvious appears when even a light wind blows ashes out of the ash catcher dish!  The solution was to purchase and install a large capacity ash catcher # 65143.  Another minor irritation was having to wear a glove to adjust the hot lid damper.  Only solution was to purchase a # 63070 damper kit and remove the nylon handle, then install it on the original damper. Handle alone did not appear to be available for purchase, but it should be factory installed on the damper during assembly...Hot damper is a very obvious safety matter.  After adding these two features to the grill I am very pleased with it.
Results.Title: Two issues result in loss of two stars on rating.

Results.ReviewText: Weber's name and well-made products is widely known. But, unlike other manufacturers - who were once known as only selling premium, well-made products but have not maintained that level of quality in the face of higher cost of living these days - Weber does indeed continue to maintain their self-imposed high level of well-made products using durable materials, BRAVO, Weber!!
Results.Title: LOVE my new well-made, durable Weber Grill!

Results.ReviewText: Have used a weber kettle my whole life for grilling.  My Dad used one so I continue the tradition.  This is my first 22" - used 18" for 30+ years.  Only 2 of us in the house so not sure the 22" was necessary but will be good when guests or family join us.  Is a little different cooking on the larger kettle but I am figuring it out.  Would not use any other type of grill!
Results.Title: Love the Kettle

Results.ReviewText: Weber Charcoal Grill has always been a standard. I've had many that lasted for decades.
Results.Title: One of the Best!

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. I love cooking with charcoal. Very well constructed
Results.Title: Simply the best!

Results.ReviewText: As always it is a solid unit that cooks very well. Wouldnt hesitate on spending the money, dont buy a cheap kncokoff.
Results.Title: Superb Grill

Results.ReviewText: Grill is great, but quality control was lacking. I received 2 hardware bags of the same parts, but the bad was missing with clips.  Had to wait 10 days for parts.  Mistakes happen but....still ruined July 4th
Results.Title: Parts missing!

Results.ReviewText: Love this Weber Charcoal Grill and have had one since 1993. Propane grills do good but a charcoal grill adds so much flavor that you can't get with a propane grill. Making Thanksgiving turkey is so easy and tasty. Not to mention saving the electrical costs. Great grill and Weber makes it great!!!
Results.Title: Great Charcoal Grill

Results.ReviewText: Very versatile grill and controlling temperature is difficult without a thermometer on the lid. But with my probe it was easy. Also like the design of the lid hook inside made my grilling much easier not hving to find a spot to put the lid down to check my meat and refill charcoal. Do recommend geting the upgrade on the cooking grates makes refill of charcoal much easier.
Results.Title: New Grill

Results.ReviewText: I just replaced two of these grills. One went to my son, and the other had seen better days ( if I had wanted I probably could have replaced the wood handles and kept going ) they were both at least 30 years old. Weber makes great grills. In my job I drive a lot of side streets. Did you ever notice of all the grills thrown out how few and I mean few Weber grills you see . They last forever…I also have a gas Weber…..
Results.Title: Gas or charcoal Weber is the best!

Results.ReviewText: Absolutely love this grill.  This is my third Weber Kettle grill.  My first two lasted 20 years or so.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: It takes me back to childhood and my dad using a charcoal grill. And the warranty is awesome.
Results.Title: Love it!

Results.ReviewText: Reviews were glowing. But my unit is hard to start (never needed a chimney with many grills Ive had over 50 years)   Finally gets hot but burns out quickly.  Better to vrill in a skillet on open fire. Terrible
Results.Title: Overrated

Results.UserLocation: Academy sports in New Bern, NC
Results.ReviewText: THIS, the best invention ever!! I use it as a grill and smoker and it's wonderful! I just smoked a pork butt and of course it turned out great! This new one makes my fourth.
Results.Title: Get it for the win. Smoke and grill anything

Results.ReviewText: Not as sturdy as previous version. Metal is all around much thinner
Results.Title: Not the same quality

Results.ReviewText: It works great for smoking and grilling, especially with the snake method. I was suggested to get it from cooking with kunchi on tiktok.
Results.Title: Cooking with Kunchi told me to get it

Results.ReviewText: Quality and customer service has gone down. :) used to be the best!
Results.Title: Not the old Weber

Results.ReviewText: Not liking the way the grill top hooks to the side of the base. Could have a larger hook to make easier and perform better.
Results.Title: Top not hooking easily to base!

Results.ReviewText: Great quality.  Perfect size.  Works well.  Definitely enjoying our summer BBQs
Results.Title: Perfect for summer BBQs

Results.ReviewText: Well designed but one inch to cover lip was not enameled, the cooking grill was slightly bent, cooking grill is very thin, legs are very thin.
Results.Title: Original Kettle Charcoal Grill

Results.ReviewText: This is the best grill ever made. Simple and eas to use. I’ve had an original for 30 plus years. For a couple years I tried a gas grill but just couldn’t do it. I had to get back to charcoal, I also thought about trying another brand but I just couldn’t dit. They say you can’t stop a Train, well you can’t beat a Webber. And this time I got the rotisserie kit with it, and holy cow, I don’t know why I didn’t do it sooner. Back to loving to barb b q again.
Results.Title: Best grill ever made

Results.ReviewText: I have had gas grills for years now and when my last gas grill finally gave up, I wanted to get back to charcoal.  The only grill I would have is a Webber.  I got it from Amazon in less than a week and had it together in less than a half hour.  The only drawback was it was missing the screw that holds the handle on, so I looked through my junk draw and found a replacement, and all was fine.  My first cook on the grill was to say the least fantastic.  Ah that smoky flavor is back.  Thanks for putting out a great product that is also affordable.
Results.Title: I'm Back

Results.ReviewText: Metal is thin. Assembled product is somewhat wobbly. Cooking grate is thin. Lid must be carefully hung or it easily misses the hook. Char broil has a sturdier and heavier charcoal grill for $99 on sale at Lowe’s.
Results.Title: It’s okay but thin.

Results.ReviewText: I was looking for a new grill and come across the GREAT weber kettle grill, i love the versatility of being a grill, smoker, even a pizza oven.
Results.Title: The GOAT of the grill

Results.ReviewText: So many uses of the grill. From standard grilling to a smoker to a fire pit. Cook anything and everything on this mobile grill. Take it everywhere with me. Camping , to the park , home, to a friends and even right in the bed of my pick up at work for a great lunch for every trade on the job site.
Results.Title: Multiple uses of a 22" grill
